title: An Empirical Analysis of EOS Blockchain: Architecture, Contract, and Security
abstract: arXiv:2505.15051v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of blockchain technology, various blockchain systems are exhibiting vitality and potential. As a representative of Blockchain 3.0, the EOS blockchain has been regarded as a strong competitor to Ethereum. Nevertheless, compared with Bitcoin and Ethereum, academic research and in-depth analyses of EOS remain scarce. To address this gap, this study conducts a comprehensive investigation of the EOS blockchain from five key dimensions: system architecture, decentralization, performance, smart contracts, and behavioral security. The architectural analysis focuses on six core components of the EOS system, detailing their functionalities and operational workflows. translated_title: EOS区块链的实证分析：架构、合约与安全
translated_abstract: 随着区块链技术的快速发展，各类区块链系统正展现出蓬勃的活力与潜力。作为区块链3.0的代表，EOS区块链一直被视为以太坊的有力竞争者。然而，与比特币和以太坊相比，针对EOS的学术研究和深入分析仍然十分匮乏。为填补这一空白，本研究从五个关键维度对EOS区块链进行了全面调查：系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约以及行为安全。架构分析聚焦于EOS系统的六个核心组件，详细阐述了它们的功能和运行流程。基于XBlock数据共享平台数据的去中心化与性能评估揭示了若干关键问题：账户活跃度低、超级节点选举过程参与有限、区块生产者集合变化极小等。
tldr: 本研究首次从系统架构、去中心化、性能、智能合约和行为安全五个维度对EOS区块链进行了全面的实证分析，揭示了账户活跃度低、超级节点选举参与有限等关键问题。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first comprehensive empirical analysis of the EOS blockchain across five key dimensions—architecture, decentralization, performance, smart contracts, and behavioral security—revealing critical issues such as low account activity and limited participation in supernode elections.
